sanskrit: ūrdhvo rohito adhi nāke asthād viśvā rūpāṇi janayan yuvā kaviḥ | tigmenāgnir jyotiṣā vi bhāti tṛtīye cakre rajasi priyāṇi ||
english: Rohita has stood erect above the vault of heaven, the youthful seer generating all forms. Agni blazes with sharp light; in the third wheel of the atmosphere the beloved things shine.

sanskrit: sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabho jātavedā ghṛtāhutaḥ somapṛṣṭhaḥ suvīraḥ | mā mā hāsīn nāthito net tvā jahāni gopoṣaṃ ca me vīrapoṣaṃ ca dhehi ||
english: The thousand-horned bull, Jātavedas, fed with oblations of ghee, whose back is Soma, possessing good heroes — do not abandon me, I implore you, lest I abandon you. Bestow on me increase in cattle and increase in heroes.

sanskrit: rohito yajñasya janitā mukhaṃ ca rohitāya vācā śrotreṇa manasā juhomi | rohitaṃ devā yanti sumanasyamānāḥ sa mā rohaiḥ sāmityai rohayāti ||
english: Rohita is the begetter and the mouth of the sacrifice. With speech, hearing, and mind I offer oblation to Rohita. The gods go to Rohita with benevolent hearts. May he lift me up; going together, may he cause me to ascend.

sanskrit: rohito yajñaṃ vy adadhād viśvakarmaṇe tasmāt tejāṃsy upa memāny āguḥ | vocayaṃ te nābhiṃ bhuvanasyādhi majmani ||
english: Rohita distributed the sacrifice to Viśvakarman; therefore these vital powers have come to me. I shall declare your navel upon the greatness of the world.

sanskrit: ā tvā ruroha bṛhaty uta paṅktir ā kakud varcasā viśvavedaḥ | ā tvā rurohoṣṇihākṣaraṃ vaṣaṭkāra ā tvā ruroha rohito retasā saha ||
english: The bṛhatī meter has ascended you, and the paṅkti; the kakubh has ascended you with brilliance, O Vishvaveda. The uṣṇih, the syllable, the vaṣaṭkāra have ascended you; Rohita together with seed has ascended you.

sanskrit: ayaṃ vaste garbhaṃ pṛthivyā divaṃ vaste 'yam antarikṣam | ayaṃ bradhnasya viṣṭapaḥ svar lokān sam ānaśe ||
english: This one clothes the womb of the earth; this one clothes heaven and the atmosphere. This one has reached the luminous dwelling of the blazing sun, the celestial realms.

sanskrit: vācaspate pṛthivī naḥ syonā syonā yonis talpā suśevā | ihaiva prāṇaḥ sakye no astu taṃ tvā parameṣṭhin pary agnir varcasā dadhātu ||
english: O Lord of Speech, may earth be pleasant for us, pleasant the womb, the couch, most auspicious. May breath remain here among us in friendship. Around you, O Parameṣṭhin, may Agni set you with radiance.

sanskrit: vācaspata ṛtavaḥ pañca vaiśvakarmaṇāḥ pari ye babhūvuḥ | (…) (…) pari rohito varcasā dadhātu ||
english: O Lord of Speech, the five seasons belonging to Viśvakarman that have come around — [...] [...] may Rohita establish around with radiance.

sanskrit: vācaspate saumanasaṃ manaś ca goṣṭhe no gā ramaya yoniṣu prajām | ihaiva prāṇaḥ sakhye no astu taṃ tvā parameṣṭhin pary ahaṃ varcasā dadhāmi ||
english: O Lord of Speech, goodwill and mind — let our cattle rest content in the stall, and offspring in their wombs. May breath remain here among us in friendship. Around you, O Parameṣṭhin, I myself establish with radiance.

sanskrit: pari tvā dhāt savitā devo agnir varcasā mitrāvaruṇāv abhi tvā | sarvā arātīr apakrāmann udehi- -idaṃ rāṣṭraṃ kṛṇuhi sūnṛtāvat ||
english: May divine Savitṛ establish around you with radiance; may Agni and Mitra-Varuṇa look upon you. All grudging hostile powers depart — rise up! Make this realm full of true and pleasant things.

sanskrit: yaṃ tvā pṛṣatī rathe pṛṣṭir vahati rohitaḥ | śubhā yāsi riṇann apaḥ | tenemaṃ brahmaṇaspate rohaṃ rohayottamam ||
english: You whom the dappled mare carries on the chariot as a dappled back — you, Rohita, travel beautifully, releasing the waters. By him, O Brahmaṇaspati, cause this highest ascent, the great rising.

sanskrit: anuvratā rohiṇī rohitasya sūriḥ suparṇā bṛhatī suvarcāḥ | tayā vājān viśvarūpāṃ jayema tayā viśyāḥ pṛtanā abhi ṣyāma ||
english: Rohiṇī, devoted to the vow of Rohita, noble, well-winged, vast, of great brilliance — with her may we win prizes of all forms; with her may we overcome the battles of the clans.

sanskrit: idaṃ sado rohiṇī rohitasya- -asau panthāḥ pṛṣatī yena yāti | tāṃ gandharvāḥ kaśyapā un nayanti tāṃ rakṣanti kavayo 'pramādam ||
english: This is the seat of Rohiṇī belonging to Rohita; yonder is the path along which the dappled one travels. The Gandharvas, the Kashyapas, lead her upward; the poets guard her with unwavering attention.

sanskrit: sūryasyāśvā harayaḥ ketumantaḥ sadā vahanty amṛtāḥ sukhaṃ ratham | ghṛtapāvā rohito bhrājamāno divaṃ devaḥ pṛṣatīm ā viveṣa ||
english: The tawny horses of the sun, bearing banners, immortal, always carry the chariot with ease. Rohita the god, drinking ghee, blazing, has entered heaven and the dappled cow.

sanskrit: yo rohito vṛṣabhas tigmaśṛṅgaḥ pary agniṃ pari sūryaṃ babhūva | yo viṣṭabhnāti pṛthivīṃ divaṃ ca tasmād devā adhi sṛṣṭīḥ sṛjante ||
english: Rohita the bull with sharp horns, who has come to encompass Agni and encompass the sun, who props up earth and heaven — from him the gods release their creations.

sanskrit: rohito divam āruhan mahatas pary arṇavāt | sarvā ruroha rohito ruhaḥ ||
english: Rohita, ascending heaven, from the great ocean all around — Rohita has ascended everywhere, the ascender.

sanskrit: vi mimīṣva payasvatī ghṛtācīṃ devānāṃ dhenur anapaspṛg eṣā | indraḥ somaṃ pibatu kṣemo astv agniḥ pra stautu vi mṛdho nudasva ||
english: Measure out this milk-rich, ghee-rich cow of the gods, unrivaled — she is not to be touched improperly. Let Indra drink the Soma; may there be peace; let Agni sing forth — drive away the adversaries.

sanskrit: samiddho agniḥ samidhāno ghṛtavṛddho ghṛtāhutaḥ | abhīṣāḍ viśvāṣāḍ agniḥ sapatnān hantu ye mama ||
english: Agni is kindled, blazing up, nourished by ghee, fed with ghee — Agni the conquering, the all-conquering, let him smite my rivals.

sanskrit: hantv enān pra dahatv agnir yo naḥ pṛtanyati | kravyādāgninā vayaṃ sapatnān pra dahāmasi ||
english: Let Agni smite and burn those who attack us. With fire that eats raw flesh we burn our rivals.

sanskrit: agne sapatnam adharaṃ pādayāsmad vyathayā sajātam utpipānaṃ bṛhaspate | indrāgnī mitrāvaruṇāv adhare padyantām apratimanyūyamānāḥ ||
english: O Agni, cast the rival down away from us; O Bṛhaspati, make the kinsman who rises against us stumble. May Indra-Agni and Mitra-Varuṇa fall upon those below, showing no pity.

sanskrit: avācīnān ava jahi- -indra vajreṇa bāhumān | adhā sapatnān mamakān agnes tejobhir ā dade ||
english: Strike those who face downward down, O Indra, with your thunderbolt, O you of mighty arms. Then my rivals I seize with the fierces of Agni.

sanskrit: udyan tvaṃ deva sūrya sapatnān me +'dharān kṛṇu | avainān aśmanā jahi te yantv adhamaṃ tamaḥ ||
english: Rising, O divine Sun, make my rivals fall below. Strike them down with a stone; may they go into the lowest darkness.

sanskrit: vatso virājo vṛṣabho matīnām ā ruroha śukrapṛṣṭho 'ntarikṣam | ghṛteṇārkam abhy arcanti vatsaṃ brahma santaṃ brahmaṇā vardhayantu ||
english: The calf of virāj, the bull of thoughts, bright-backed, has ascended the atmosphere. With ghee they praise the calf as the hymn of praise; may the priests make him grow — he who is brahman — with sacred utterance.

sanskrit: divaṃ ca roha pṛthivīṃ ca roha rāṣṭraṃ ca roha draviṇaṃ ca roha | prajāṃ ca rohāmṛtaṃ ca roha rohitena tanvaṃ saṃ spṛśasva ||
english: Ascend heaven and ascend earth; ascend dominion and ascend wealth; ascend offspring and ascend immortality. With Rohita touch your own body.

sanskrit: ye devā rāṣṭrabhṛto 'bhito yanti sūryam | tebhiṣ ṭe rohitaḥ saṃvidāno rāṣṭraṃ dadhātu sumanasyamānaḥ ||
english: The gods who uphold the realm, who travel around the sun on every side — may Rohita, in agreement with them, benevolently bestow the realm upon you.

sanskrit: ut tvā yajñā brahmapūtā vahanty adhvagato harayas tvā vahanti | tiraḥ samudram ati rocase 'rṇavam ||
english: The sacrifices purified by brahman carry you upward; the tawny steeds of the path carry you. You shine beyond the ocean, beyond the flood.

sanskrit: rohite dyāvāpṛthivī adhi śrite vasujiti gojiti saṃjiti saṃdhanājiti | sahasraṃ yasya draviṇāni sapta ca voceyaṃ te nābhiṃ bhuvanasyādhi majmani ||
english: Upon Rohita heaven and earth are founded — winning wealth, winning cattle, winning all, winning by union. His treasures are a thousand and seven. I shall declare your navel upon the greatness of the world.

sanskrit: yaśā yāsi pradiśo diśo 'nu yaśāḥ paśūnām uta carṣaṇīnām | yaśāḥ pṛthivyā adityā upasthe 'ham asmi saviteva cāruḥ ||
english: Full of fame you travel through the directions and the quarters; full of fame among cattle and among men. Glorious in the lap of the earth, of Aditi, I am as beautiful as Savitṛ.

sanskrit: amutra sann iha vettha- -iha san tāni paśyati | itaḥ paśyanti rocanaṃ divi sūryaṃ vipaścitam ||
english: Being there, he knows things here; being here, he sees those things. From here the wise see the shining sun, the all-knowing, in heaven.

sanskrit: devo devam arcayaty antaś caraty arṇave | samānam agnim indhate taṃ viduḥ kavayaḥ pare ||
english: The god worships the god, moving within the ocean. They kindle the same fire; the far-seeing poets know him.
